answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 158706 Country: Australia Title: For the 4 sunnah rakahs before Asr and before Isha, does it have to be prayed in sets of 2 rakah each or 4 rakah salah altogether. Question: For the 4 sunnah rakahs before Asr and before Isha, does it have to be prayed in sets of 2 rakah each or 4 rakah salah altogether. Answer ID: 158706 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 552/427/SD=5/1439) It is mustahab to offer four rakahs before Asr and Isha salah with one salam. (ويستحب أربع قبل العصر ، وقبل العشاء وبعدها بتسليمة ) (الدر المختار مع رد المحتار : 23/2، كتاب الصلاة، باب الوتر والنوافل). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
